title: So cute!
text: So cute!. Because I've collected mice created in various fabrics, styles, etc. for more years than I care to admit, and many of them are Christmas (of course!) I can truly say these are VERY special and will be an adorable addition to my  decorations!

description: "OUR INSPIRATION We’re constantly inspired by the people, places and things around us. Kathy travels the world to pull inspiration first hand from cultures around the globe. We create product that is ahead-of-the trend, uniquely designed and constantly evolving. We embrace the unexpected, set the trends and challenge ourselves to create décor and gifts that are memorable and one-of-a-kind. We believe that a combination of the perfect sentiment and fresh design never goes out of style. Our promise is to create the designs that you love – with the expertise and product mix you desire.
